body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage using a natural weapon and the target cannot Disengage from you until its next turn.

surges.html: On a success, ignore 1 Defense granted by equipment.
Until your next turn, reduce damage from Burning or Bleeding by 1, minimum 0.

rider.title: PREDATOR ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Apex Form. While maintained: The first time each turn you damage a wounded creature, gain +1 Defense until your next turn.
